description:
Location: Union Square, New York City
 Work Model: In-Office, 5 Days/Week
 Industry: AI Infrastructure / Data Infrastructure / SaaS
 Compensation: $190,000–$215,000 base salary + meaningful early-stage equity (target total compensation up to ~$250K–$260K)
 
 About the Company
 Our partner is a rapidly growing, venture-backed AI infrastructure startup building the technology that enables software companies to migrate customer data between complex systems quickly and reliably. Their platform automates one of the most difficult problems in enterprise software adoption—moving and transforming data across CRMs, ERPs, and other systems of record—allowing customers to onboard in hours instead of weeks.
 The company has experienced exceptional growth, increasing revenue nearly 4x in the first half of the year , and is now scaling both its engineering and go-to-market teams. Their product sits at the intersection of AI, data infrastructure, and workflow automation, solving technically challenging problems for a growing customer base.
 
 The Opportunity
 Our partner is hiring Senior Full Stack Engineers to help build the next generation of their product. This is a backend-heavy product engineering role focused on developing customer-facing features, building scalable data movement systems, and solving complex engineering problems that directly impact customers.
 This isn't an environment where engineers simply work through tickets. The team is looking for builders who enjoy shaping product direction, collaborating closely with customers, and using AI as a core part of their development workflow. You'll work alongside experienced engineers in a highly collaborative environment where ownership, initiative, and product thinking are expected from day one.
 
 Responsibilities
 Design, build, and maintain full-stack product features with an emphasis on backend systems
 Develop scalable data movement pipelines and workflow automation capabilities
 Partner with product, engineering, and occasionally customers to solve real-world technical challenges
 Contribute to product direction by providing thoughtful technical feedback and implementation ideas
 Build AI-enabled product capabilities and incorporate modern AI tooling into daily development workflows
 Write clean, maintainable TypeScript code across frontend and backend services
 Help improve platform performance, reliability, and developer experience
 
 Requirements
 5–7+ years of professional software engineering experience (4 years minimum considered)
 Strong experience building full-stack applications using TypeScript and React 
 Experience developing backend systems, APIs, and data-intensive applications
 Product-minded engineer who enjoys solving customer problems—not just implementing requirements
 Comfortable working in fast-paced startup environments with significant ownership
 Demonstrated use of AI tools within your engineering workflow
 Strong communication skills and willingness to collaborate across product and engineering teams
 Nice to Have 
 Experience with ETL, data movement, workflow orchestration, or pipeline development
 Experience with browser automation, web scraping, or automation tooling
 Experience working with AI agents or modern LLM frameworks
 Familiarity with AWS, Postgres, or Temporal
